judgments.reason: The model articulation never asserts or explains that the three-coin commission is applied before deducting the winner's bid or that this enables bids above available coins to win; transcript shows normal payment then commission, with no discrepancy observed.

The model did not articulate the mechanism that waiting (acting later) lets an uncommitted focal player observe sealed rival bid values and then respond. In the transcript the focal player committed first and later saw a revealed rival bid while already committed, so the claimed precommit information advantage was neither articulated nor demonstrated.
No early settlement or closing-with-unauctioned-lots was observed; the model articulation contains no claim or mechanism showing the game settles via close while lots remain unsold.

The model articulation does not claim or explain that catalog purchases receive the three-coin auction commission, and the transcript shows buying is explicitly described as not an auction win with no evidence of substituted commission.
